summary: The note describes religion in the Comoros. Sunni Islam is the dominant faith, representing as much as 99% of the population. A minority, mostly immigrants from metropolitan France, are Roman Catholic. The Comoros is the only Muslim-majority country in Southern Africa and the second southernmost Muslim-majority territory after the French territory of Mayotte.
one_line: Overview of religion in the Comoros, where Sunni Islam dominates and the country is the only Muslim-majority state in Southern Africa.
key_facts: Sunni Islam is the dominant religion in the Comoros, representing as much as 99% of the population.
A minority of the population of the Comoros is Roman Catholic.
The Roman Catholic minority in the Comoros is mostly made up of immigrants from metropolitan France.
The Comoros is the only Muslim-majority country in Southern Africa.
The Comoros is the second southernmost Muslim-majority territory.
The southernmost Muslim-majority territory is the French territory of Mayotte.
